stories.title: Playwright screenshot skill for OpenRCT2 web
stories.description:
Create scripts/reskin/screenshot_game.py — a Playwright script that:
1. Starts the OpenRCT2 web server (scripts/serve-emscripten.py) pointing at a directory containing the built wasm output
2. Launches headless Chromium with SharedArrayBuffer support (args: --enable-features=SharedArrayBuffer)
3. Navigates to index.html, waits for the canvas to appear (selector: canvas#canvas with display != none)
4. Waits for the game to load (the #loadingWebassembly element gets removed when loading completes — wait for it to be detached)
5. Takes a screenshot and saves to a specified output path
6. Shuts down browser and server

CLI: python3 screenshot_game.py --serve-dir <dir> --output <path.png> [--port 8000] [--wait-seconds 10]

Use playwright.sync_api (Python sync API). The server needs COOP/COEP headers (serve-emscripten.py handles this).

IMPORTANT: The script must handle the case where no wasm build exists gracefully — print a clear error message and exit 1. Do NOT try to build the wasm.

Test: Create scripts/reskin/test_screenshot_game.py with at least 2 tests:
- test_server_starts_and_stops: verify the COOP/COEP server can start on a temp dir and respond to requests
- test_missing_serve_dir: verify graceful error when dir doesn't exist

Do NOT test the full Playwright flow in unit tests (requires wasm build). The integration test is manual.

stories.title: Gemini visual judge script
stories.description:
Create scripts/reskin/judge_screenshot.py — invokes Gemini CLI to visually judge a game screenshot.

CLI: python3 judge_screenshot.py <screenshot.png> [--reference <ref.png>] [--criteria 'text']

Behavior:
1. Takes a screenshot path (required) and optional reference image path
2. Builds a prompt asking Gemini to evaluate the screenshot:
   - If reference provided: 'Compare these two screenshots. The first is the original, the second is reskinned. Evaluate: (1) Did the reskin change the visual style? (2) Are game elements still recognizable? (3) Is the overall quality acceptable? Rate 1-10 and explain.'
   - If no reference: 'Evaluate this game screenshot. Is it rendering correctly? Are there visual artifacts, black screens, or missing textures? Rate quality 1-10 and explain.'
   - If --criteria provided, append it to the prompt
3. Invokes: gemini -p "<prompt>" -m gemini-3.1-pro-preview --include-directories <dir-containing-images> --yolo --output-format text 2>/dev/null
4. Prints the Gemini response
5. Parses the rating (look for 'X/10' pattern) and exits 0 if >= 5, exit 1 if < 5 or unparseable

Test: Create scripts/reskin/test_judge_screenshot.py with tests:
- test_build_prompt_single_image: verify prompt construction without reference
- test_build_prompt_with_reference: verify prompt includes comparison language
- test_build_prompt_with_criteria: verify custom criteria is appended
- test_parse_rating_valid: verify '7/10' parses to 7
- test_parse_rating_missing: verify None returned when no rating found

Keep the Gemini invocation in a separate function so tests don't need the CLI.
